# Projectile variant originals

The legal command evidence retains the chosen facets. All seven Sorcerous Burst
and six Chromatic Orb declarations expose neither an effect_id nor a selected
element in either public stream; they cannot activate fixed-element alternatives.
Their actual attack outcomes in this cohort are Miss. This is producer evidence,
not native alternative output or visual approval.

Acid Arrow's attempted miss seed 2 actually Hits and is retained as such. The
bounded additional seeds 3 and 7 also Hit. Seed 5 discloses Crit Miss and owns
the finite delivery/splash output qualification. No residue cells are invented.
The scenario title of the initial attempt reflects its intended setup, not its
actual outcome; recording.json and the journal retain the actual Hit.

The first recording attempt gave an SRD knight an unsupported level parameter;
those setup failures remain under .runtime/projectile-variant-recordings and are
not successful originals. The successful cohort removes that invalid setup.
No packet, RNG result, target or damage was rewritten.
